info.title: Pipelinq CRM Register
info.description: Client Relationship Management register for the Pipelinq Nextcloud app. Manages clients, contacts, leads, requests, and pipelines.

x-openregister.description: CRM data model — thin client on OpenRegister, no own database tables

pipelinq.title: Pipelinq
pipelinq.description: Client Relationship Management register for Pipelinq — manages clients, contacts, leads, requests, and pipelines using Schema.org and vCard (RFC 6350) standards.

client.title: Client
client.summary: A client (person or organization) in the CRM
client.description: Represents a client entity — either a natural person or an organization. Mapped to Schema.org Person/Organization and vCard (RFC 6350) field conventions. Clients are the primary relationship entity in Pipelinq.

name.description: Full name of the person or organization (schema:name / vCard FN)

type.description: Entity type — person or organization (maps to schema:Person or schema:Organization)
type.title: Client type

contactsUid.description: Nextcloud Contacts UID linking this client to a vCard in the user's addressbook

contact.title: Contact
contact.summary: A contact person linked to a client
contact.description: Represents a contact person associated with a client organization. Properties align with vCard (RFC 6350) field conventions.

name.description: Full name of the contact person (vCard FN)

role.description: Job title or role within the organization (vCard ROLE)
role.title: Role

client.description: UUID reference to the parent client object

contactsUid.description: Nextcloud Contacts UID linking this contact to a vCard in the user's addressbook

lead.title: Lead
lead.summary: A sales lead or business opportunity
lead.description: Represents a sales lead — a potential deal or business opportunity linked to a client. Tracks value, probability, pipeline stage, and lifecycle status. Mapped to Schema.org Demand.

win.description: Close the lead as won. Authorization: assignee or a member of the sales group.

lose.description: Close the lead as lost. Authorization: assignee or a member of the sales group.

daysSinceActivity.description: Staleness — days since the lead was last touched. Derived from @self.updated (the object's last save) so it is always fresh on read; lead-management spec staleness scenario (Scenario 49). A consumer flags the lead as stale when this exceeds the configured threshold.

daysInStage.description: Aging — days the lead has spent in its current pipeline stage. Diffs stageEnteredAt against now; falls back to @self.created when the stage-change writer has not yet populated stageEnteredAt (lead-management spec Aging Indicator, Scenario 50/51).

weightedValue.description: Probability-weighted lead value (value * probability / 100). Single-object derived figure feeding the Pipeline Value KPI. NOTE: the lead-management spec's 'lead value from line items' sum (Scenario: Calculate lead value from line items) is a cross-schema aggregation over leadProduct rows and is NOT expressible as a single-object calculation — it remains a service/frontend concern per ADR-031 exception (2).

qualificationScore.description: Backend qualification score (0-100), materialised on every save. Resolves the lead-management spec 'frontend vs backend qualification score' open question: the score is a backend calculation; the frontend reads it. Point weights mirror the spec's default scoring criteria (Scenario: Auto-calculate qualification score on lead save): value present +10, value above EUR 10000 +20, client linked +15, contact linked +10, source referral/partner +15, expectedCloseDate set +10, priority high/urgent +10, description present +5.

client.description: UUID reference to the associated client

contact.description: UUID reference to the associated contact person

source.description: Origin of the lead (e.g., website, referral, cold-call, advertisement, event)
source.title: Source

expectedCloseDate.description: Expected close date for the opportunity

assignee.description: Nextcloud user UID of the assigned sales representative
assignee.title: Assignee

pipeline.description: UUID reference to the pipeline this lead is tracked in

stageOrder.description: Numeric position of the current stage in the pipeline

description.description: Free-text description of the opportunity (used by the qualification-score calculation: presence is worth +5 points)

stageEnteredAt.description: Timestamp the lead entered its current pipeline stage. Set by the stage-change writer; the aging calculation diffs this against now. When unset, aging falls back to @self.created.

qualificationScore.description: Backend-computed qualification score (0-100). Materialised by the x-openregister-calculations.qualificationScore annotation on every save — never written by service code. Resolves the lead-management spec 'frontend vs backend qualification score' open question in favour of a backend calculation.

request.title: Request
request.summary: A service request (verzoek) — the pre-state of a case
request.description: Represents a client service request that may be converted to a case in Procest. Tracks status lifecycle, priority, assignment, and optional pipeline placement.

start.description: Pick up the request for handling. Authorization: the assignee or a member of the sales group.

complete.description: Resolve the request successfully. Authorization: the assignee.

reject.description: Reject the request. Authorization: the assignee or a member of the sales group.

convert.description: Convert the request into a case (Procest). Authorization: the assignee.

client.description: UUID reference to the associated client

contact.description: UUID reference to the associated contact person

status.description: Current status in the request lifecycle
status.title: Status

assignee.description: Nextcloud user UID of the assigned handler
assignee.title: Assignee

requestedAt.description: Date and time the request was submitted

pipeline.description: UUID reference to the pipeline this request is tracked in

stageOrder.description: Numeric position of the current stage in the pipeline

channel.description: Intake channel for the request (e.g., phone, email, website)
channel.title: Channel

queue.description: UUID reference to the queue this request is assigned to
queue.title: Queue

caseReference.description: UUID reference to the converted Procest case

complaint.title: Complaint
complaint.summary: A customer complaint registered for tracking and resolution
complaint.description: Represents a customer complaint linked to a client and optionally a contact person. Tracks status lifecycle, priority, category, SLA deadline, and resolution. Mapped to Schema.org ComplainAction.

start.description: Begin handling the complaint. Authorization: the assignee or a member of the sales group.

resolve.description: Resolve the complaint to the customer's satisfaction. Authorization: the assignee.

reject.description: Reject the complaint as unfounded or out of scope. Authorization: the assignee or a member of the sales group.

status.description: Current status in the complaint lifecycle
status.title: Status

channel.description: Channel through which the complaint was received
channel.title: Channel

client.description: UUID reference to the associated client

contact.description: UUID reference to the associated contact person

assignedTo.description: Nextcloud user UID of the assigned handler
assignedTo.title: Assigned to

slaDeadline.description: SLA deadline for complaint resolution, calculated from category config

resolvedAt.description: Date and time the complaint was resolved or rejected

resolution.description: Explanation of how the complaint was resolved or why it was rejected

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.summary: A thin CRM pipeline config mapping stage rules onto a Deck board
pipeline.description: Represents a CRM pipeline configuration — maps pipeline stages to a Deck board and its stacks, preserving CRM-specific semantics (probability, won/closed/default flags) that Deck itself does not model. Board mechanics (columns, cards, drag-and-drop) are provided by the OpenRegister deck leaf. Mapped to Schema.org ItemList.

deckBoardId.description: NC Deck board ID that this pipeline is realised as

stages.description: Ordered list of CRM stage rules mapped onto Deck stacks (schema:ItemListElement)

deckStackId.description: NC Deck stack ID that this stage is mapped to

probability.description: Default win probability percentage for this stage (0-100)

isClosed.description: Whether this stage represents a closed/terminal state

isWon.description: Whether this closed stage represents a won/successful outcome. Only valid when isClosed is true.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default entry stage for new leads/requests in this pipeline
Whether this is the default pipeline for its entity type

product.title: Product
product.summary: A product or service that the organization sells
product.description: Represents a product or service in the CRM catalog. Linked to leads via LeadProduct line items for accurate pipeline valuation. Mapped to Schema.org Product.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit or product code (schema:sku)

unitPrice.description: Default selling price per unit in EUR (schema:price)

cost.description: Cost to the organization per unit (for margin calculation)

category.description: UUID reference to a ProductCategory object
category.title: Category

type.description: Whether this is a physical product or a service
type.title: Type

status.description: Whether the product is available for sale
status.title: Status

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g., each, hour, license, month)

taxRate.description: Tax percentage (0-100). Default: 21 (Dutch BTW). Auto-populated from btwClass when set.

btwClass.description: Dutch BTW class. Governs receipt printing and invoice BTW labels and drives taxRate: hoog (21%), laag (9%), nul (0%), vrijgesteld (exempt, 0%).
btwClass.title: BTW Class

barcode.description: EAN-13 / UPC-A barcode for scanner lookup (schema:gtin)

duration.description: Service duration in minutes (behandelingen, afspraken). Relevant when type=service.

variants.description: Variant matrix (e.g. size x colour). Each entry has its own sku, price override and barcode.

sku.description: Variant stock keeping unit (unique within the product)

unitPrice.description: Per-variant selling price in EUR. Defaults to the parent product unitPrice.

status.description: Whether the variant is available for sale

modifierGroups.description: Configurable add-on groups prompted at POS checkout (e.g. milk type, toppings).

required.description: Whether the customer must choose at least one option

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple options may be selected

min.description: Minimum number of options to select

max.description: Maximum number of options to select

options.description: Selectable options with their price adjustments

priceAdjustment.description: Amount added to (or subtracted from) the line price in EUR

priceTiers.description: Quantity-break pricing. The applicable tier is the one with the highest minQuantity that is at most the ordered quantity. Stored sorted ascending by minQuantity.

minQuantity.description: Minimum ordered quantity for this tier to apply

unitPrice.description: Per-unit price in EUR when the tier applies

productCategory.title: Product Category
productCategory.description: Represents a product category for hierarchical grouping. Categories can have parent categories for tree structures. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTermSet.

parent.description: UUID reference to parent category (for hierarchy)

order.description: Display order within the same parent level

leadProduct.title: Lead Product
leadProduct.summary: A line item linking a product to a lead
leadProduct.description: Represents a product line item on a lead — an instance of a product with deal-specific quantity, pricing, and discount. The total is computed as quantity * unitPrice * (1 - discount/100). Mapped to Schema.org Offer.

lead.description: UUID reference to the parent Lead

unitPrice.description: Price per unit (pre-populated from Product.unitPrice, can be overridden)

notes.description: Line item notes (e.g., annual license, setup fee)

intakeForm.title: Intake Form
intakeForm.summary: A public intake form for capturing leads from external websites
intakeForm.description: Defines a customizable web form that can be embedded on external websites. Submissions create contacts and leads in Pipelinq.

fields.description: Ordered list of form field definitions

fieldMappings.description: Maps form field names to contact/lead properties

targetPipeline.description: UUID of the pipeline where new leads are placed

targetStage.description: Initial pipeline stage for new leads

notifyUser.description: Nextcloud user ID to notify on new submissions

intakeSubmission.title: Intake Submission
intakeSubmission.summary: A submission received through a public intake form
intakeSubmission.description: Records each submission with submitted data, created entities, and processing status.

form.description: UUID reference to the intake form

contactId.description: UUID of created or matched contact

ip.description: Submitter IP address (for rate limiting audit)

contactmoment.title: Contactmoment
contactmoment.summary: A registered contact moment (interaction) with a client
contactmoment.description: Represents a single interaction with a client across any channel (phone, email, counter, chat, social media, letter). Mapped to Schema.org CommunicateAction and VNG Klantinteracties Contactmoment.

rules.reason: Resolved client contact moments (callback logs, counter/phone interactions) retained 2 years as the operational client-interaction record (VNG Klantinteracties), then disposed per ADR-024. DPO sign-off pending (task 4.1).
Transferred (doorverbonden) contact moments are short-lived routing records; 1-year retention before disposition. DPO sign-off pending.

subject.description: Subject of the contact moment (schema:about / Contactmoment.onderwerp)

summary.description: Summary or notes of the interaction (schema:description / Contactmoment.tekst)

client.description: UUID reference to the associated client (schema:recipient / KlantContactmoment)

request.description: UUID reference to the associated request (schema:object / ObjectContactmoment)

agent.description: Nextcloud user UID of the agent who handled the interaction (schema:agent / Contactmoment.medewerker)
agent.title: Agent

contactedAt.description: Date and time of the interaction (schema:startTime / Contactmoment.registratiedatum)

duration.description: Duration of the interaction in ISO 8601 format (schema:duration / Contactmoment.gespreksduur)

channelMetadata.description: Channel-specific metadata (e.g., call direction, email thread ID, counter location)

task.title: Task
task.summary: A callback request or follow-up task (terugbelverzoek / opvolgtaak / informatievraag)
task.description: Represents an internal task — a callback request (terugbelverzoek), follow-up task (opvolgtaak), or information request (informatievraag) assigned to a user or department. Maps to VNG InterneTaak and Schema.org Action.

claim.description: Pick up the task: caller becomes the assignee.

expire.description: Mark the task as expired (deadline passed).

reopen.description: Re-open a closed or expired task.

rules.reason: Completed task history (incl. callback requests / terugbelverzoeken) retained 2 years as operational record, then disposed per ADR-024. DPO sign-off pending (task 4.1).
Expired (never-actioned) tasks carry little record value; 1-year retention for audit, then disposed. DPO sign-off pending.

type.description: Task type — terugbelverzoek (callback), opvolgtaak (follow-up), or informatievraag (information request)
type.title: Type

assigneeUserId.description: Nextcloud user UID of the assigned handler (VNG toegewezenAanMedewerker)
assigneeUserId.title: Assignee

assigneeGroupId.description: Nextcloud group ID for team/department assignment
assigneeGroupId.title: Group

clientId.description: UUID reference to the associated client

requestId.description: UUID reference to the associated request

contactMomentSummary.description: Summary text from the originating contact moment

callbackPhoneNumber.description: Override phone number for callback (may differ from client's primary phone)

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the agent who created this task
createdBy.title: Created by

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was completed

attempts.description: Callback attempt log — each entry has timestamp, result, and notes

kennisartikel.title: Knowledge Article
kennisartikel.summary: A knowledge base article for KCC agents and citizens
kennisartikel.description: Represents a knowledge base article with rich text content, categorization, versioning, and visibility controls. Mapped to Schema.org Article. Used by KCC agents for first-call resolution and optionally published for citizen self-service.

publish.description: Publish the article so it becomes available to agents (intern) and, when visibility is openbaar, to citizens. Authorization: author or a knowledge editor.

archive.description: Withdraw the article from publication and archive it. Authorization: author or a knowledge editor.

reopen.description: Move an archived article back to concept for further editing. Authorization: author or a knowledge editor.

rules.reason: Archived (withdrawn) knowledge-base article versions retained 7 years per the Archiefwet baseline term before disposition per ADR-024. Editors archive superseded versions; this rule governs how long the archived copy is kept. DPO sign-off pending (task 4.1).
Draft (concept) articles never published carry no statutory record value; 1-year retention for clean-up of abandoned drafts. DPO sign-off pending.

summary.description: Short summary for search result snippets (schema:abstract)

visibility.description: Access level — intern (agents only) or openbaar (public)
visibility.title: Visibility

zaaktypeLinks.description: References to zaaktypen for context-aware suggestions

author.description: Nextcloud user UID of the article author
author.title: Author

lastUpdatedBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the last editor

version.description: Article version number, incremented on each edit

usefulnessScore.description: Aggregate usefulness rating score (percentage of positive ratings)

kenniscategorie.title: Knowledge Category
kenniscategorie.summary: A hierarchical category for organizing knowledge articles
kenniscategorie.description: Represents a category in the knowledge base taxonomy. Supports up to 3 levels of hierarchy via parent references.

parent.description: UUID reference to parent category for hierarchy

order.description: Display order within the same parent level

kennisfeedback.title: Knowledge Feedback
kennisfeedback.summary: Agent feedback on a knowledge article
kennisfeedback.description: Represents an agent's rating and optional improvement suggestion for a knowledge article. Supports KCS methodology for continuous knowledge improvement.

article.description: UUID reference to the rated kennisartikel

agent.description: Nextcloud user UID of the rating agent
agent.title: Agent

createdAt.description: Date and time the feedback was submitted

emailLink.title: Email Link
emailLink.summary: A link between an email and a CRM entity
emailLink.description: Stores metadata for emails synced from Nextcloud Mail and linked to Pipelinq entities. Full email body is accessed on-demand from Nextcloud Mail.

messageId.description: Email message ID from Nextcloud Mail

threadId.description: Email thread ID for conversation grouping

linkedEntityId.description: UUID of the linked CRM entity

excluded.description: Whether this email is excluded from future sync

deleted.description: Whether the source email has been deleted

calendarLink.title: Calendar Link
calendarLink.summary: A link between a calendar event and a CRM entity
calendarLink.description: Stores metadata for calendar events synced with Nextcloud Calendar and linked to Pipelinq entities.

complete.description: Mark the linked calendar event as completed (the meeting took place). Authorization: the event owner or the entity assignee.

cancel.description: Cancel the linked calendar event. Authorization: the event owner or the entity assignee.

linkedEntityId.description: UUID of the linked CRM entity

relationship.title: Relationship
relationship.summary: A typed bidirectional relationship between two contacts or clients
relationship.description: Represents a relationship between two entities (contacts and/or clients) with a typed, bidirectional link. Inverse relationships are auto-created. Mapped to Schema.org Person.knows.

fromContact.description: UUID reference to the source contact or client

toContact.description: UUID reference to the target contact or client

fromType.description: Entity type of source: contact or client

toType.description: Entity type of target: contact or client

type.description: Relationship type identifier (e.g., partner, ouder, werkgever)
type.title: Type

category.description: Category grouping for the relationship type (Familie, Professioneel, Organisatie, CRM Rol)
category.title: Category

notes.description: Optional free text context for this relationship

endDate.description: Date when the relationship ended (null = active)

survey.title: Survey
survey.description: Represents a KTO (klanttevredenheidsonderzoek) survey with configurable questions, public access token, and entity linking. Mapped to Schema.org Survey.

required.description: Whether the question must be answered

token.description: Unique public access token (UUID) for the survey response URL

linkedEntityType.description: Entity type this survey is linked to
linkedEntityType.title: Linked Entity Type

linkedEntityId.description: UUID of the specific entity this survey is linked to

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the survey creator

createdAt.description: Date and time the survey was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time the survey was last updated

surveyResponse.title: Survey Response
surveyResponse.summary: A completed survey response from a client
surveyResponse.description: Represents a single completed survey response with answers to survey questions. Linked to the parent survey via surveyId. Mapped to Schema.org CompletedSurvey.

surveyId.description: UUID reference to the parent survey

value.description: The response value (number as string for NPS/rating, text for open/multiple choice)

entityType.description: Entity type that triggered this survey response
entityType.title: Entity Type

entityId.description: UUID of the entity that triggered this response

completedAt.description: Date and time the response was submitted

ipHash.description: SHA-256 hash of respondent IP address for abuse detection

queue.title: Queue
queue.summary: A priority queue for organizing work items
queue.description: Represents a named queue for organizing requests with priority-based ordering. Used for workload distribution and skill-based routing in KCC/service desk scenarios. Mapped to Schema.org ItemList.

categories.description: Category tags for routing (matched against request categories and agent skills)

isActive.description: Whether the queue is active and accepting items
isActive.title: Active

maxCapacity.description: Maximum number of items allowed in the queue (null = unlimited)

sortOrder.description: Display order of the queue in the list

assignedAgents.description: Nextcloud user UIDs of agents assigned to work this queue

skill.title: Skill
skill.summary: A skill or expertise area for routing
skill.description: Represents a defined skill or area of expertise that can be assigned to agents. Skills are matched against request categories for routing suggestions. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTerm.

categories.description: Category tags this skill covers (matched against request categories)

isActive.description: Whether this skill is active for routing
isActive.title: Active

agentProfile.title: Agent Profile
agentProfile.description: Links a Nextcloud user to their assigned skills and routing configuration. Used for skill-based routing suggestions and workload management.

skills.description: UUID references to assigned Skill objects

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of concurrent open items for this agent

isAvailable.description: Whether this agent is available for routing suggestions
isAvailable.title: Available

posTransaction.title: POS Transaction
posTransaction.summary: A point-of-sale transaction (kassabon) with lifecycle, totals and tax breakdown
posTransaction.description: Represents a POS cart / receipt from open (draft) through payment (confirmed -> settled) or cancellation (refunded). The taxBreakdown array captures tax per BTW rate so receipts can show 9% and 21% lines separately. Totals are server-computed by PosTransactionService and must never be trusted from the client. Mapped to Schema.org Order.

confirm.description: Confirm a draft or parked cart. Authorization: the cashier who owns the transaction, a member of the POS group, or an admin. The server recomputes totals and rejects an empty cart.

settle.description: Mark a confirmed transaction as paid. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

park.description: Park a draft cart for later. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

resume.description: Resume a parked cart to draft. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

refund.description: Refund / void a confirmed or settled transaction. Authorization: a POS manager (member of the configured manager group) or an admin only.

cashier.description: Nextcloud user UID of the logged-in cashier
cashier.title: Cashier

client.description: Optional UUID reference to a client object for account sales

terminalId.description: POS terminal / register identifier, e.g. kassa-01
terminalId.title: Terminal

subtotal.description: Sum of line totals excl. tax, after line-level discounts (server-computed)

discountTotal.description: Aggregate discount amount across all lines (server-computed)

taxBreakdown.description: Per-rate tax summary, e.g. [{ rate: 21, base: 100.00, tax: 21.00 }] (server-computed)

invoiceBreakdown.description: Per-rate GL posting breakdown for shillinq, e.g. [{ rate: 21, base: 100.00, tax: 21.00, description: "Standard VAT (21%)" }] (server-computed). Shillinq posts one GL line per rate.

priceMode.description: Whether the cashier-entered unitPrice values are tax-inclusive (incl) or tax-exclusive (excl). Internal tax is always computed on the net (exclusive) base. Default: excl.
priceMode.title: Price mode

totalTax.description: Aggregate tax amount, sum of taxBreakdown[*].tax (server-computed)

total.description: Grand total incl. tax, subtotal + totalTax (server-computed)

notes.description: Optional cashier notes on the transaction

parkedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when transaction was parked

refundReason.description: Reason code / description for refund or void

cloudEventId.description: CloudEvents id of the emitted confirmation event

invoiceNumber.description: Server-allocated legal invoice number (e.g. 2026-000042) assigned once when a receipt is issued for a transaction >= EUR 100. Never accepted from the client; allocated race-safe by InvoiceSequenceService.

posTransactionLine.title: POS Line Item
posTransactionLine.summary: A single sellable line item on a POS transaction
posTransactionLine.description: One sellable item on a posTransaction. Quantity supports fractions for weight/volume items. taxAmount and lineTotal are computed on save by PosTransactionService and must never be trusted from the client. Mapped to Schema.org OrderItem.

transaction.description: UUID reference to the parent posTransaction

product.description: Optional UUID reference to a product object from the catalog

description.description: Line description -- pre-filled from product.name, or free-text

quantity.description: Number of units (supports fractions for weight/volume items)

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in EUR (pre-filled from product.unitPrice)

taxRate.description: BTW rate percentage. Default 21 (Dutch standard rate). Common values: 0, 9, 21

sortOrder.description: Display order of the line within the transaction

notes.description: Optional line-level notes, e.g. inclusief montage

refundReason.title: Refund Reason
refundReason.summary: A configurable reason code for a POS refund / return
refundReason.description: Lookup / enumeration of standard refund reasons (damaged, unwanted, wrong item, expired, cashier error, other). Managers can mark reasons active/inactive to control which appear in refund forms. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTerm.

description.description: Help text shown in the refund form

isActive.description: Whether this reason is available for new refunds
isActive.title: Active

icon.description: Optional icon identifier for the reason

posRefund.title: POS Refund
posRefund.summary: A refund / return document for a previously settled or confirmed POS transaction
posRefund.description: Represents a full or partial refund against a posTransaction. refundAmount and totalTax are server-computed by PosRefundService from the refund lines and the original transaction's persisted, server-authoritative tax data; client-supplied amounts are never trusted. Lifecycle: pending -> completed (manager confirm) or pending -> rejected. Completed and rejected refunds are immutable. Mapped to Schema.org Order (type=refund).

complete.description: Confirm a pending refund (emits reversal + stock events). Authorization: a POS manager or admin only. The cumulative over-refund cap is enforced and amounts are recomputed server-side.

reject.description: Reject a pending refund. Authorization: a POS manager or admin only.

originalTransaction.description: UUID reference to the original posTransaction being refunded
originalTransaction.title: Original transaction

cashier.description: Nextcloud user UID of the cashier processing the return
cashier.title: Cashier

refundReason.description: UUID reference to a refundReason describing the overall reason
refundReason.title: Refund reason

paymentMethod.description: Original tender method (cash, card_visa, card_mastercard, digital_wallet)
paymentMethod.title: Payment method

paymentReference.description: Transaction id from the original payment, used for tender reversal reference

refundAmount.description: Total refund amount excl. tax (server-computed from refund lines)

totalTax.description: Aggregate tax being refunded (server-computed from refund lines)

rejectionReason.description: Text reason if the refund was rejected

cloudEventId.description: CloudEvents id of the emitted refund reversal event

posRefundLine.title: POS Refund Line
posRefundLine.summary: One returnable item on a posRefund, linked to the original transaction line
posRefundLine.description: A single returned item on a posRefund. taxAmount and lineTotal are server-computed proportionally from the original posTransactionLine and the returned quantity; client-supplied amounts are never trusted. restock controls whether a stock back-in event is emitted to Shillinq on completion. Mapped to Schema.org OrderItem (type=refund-line).

refund.description: UUID reference to the parent posRefund

originalLine.description: UUID reference to the original posTransactionLine being refunded

returnedQuantity.description: Number of units being refunded (supports fractions)

returnReason.description: UUID reference to a refundReason for this specific item
returnReason.title: Return reason

restock.description: Whether the returned item should be restored to inventory
restock.title: Restock

notes.description: Line-specific return notes, e.g. dent on back corner

receiptTemplate.title: Receipt Template
receiptTemplate.description: Configures how a POS receipt is rendered: company header/footer, layout width and whether the legal-invoice (BTW) variant applies. The body is a safe placeholder template ({{ placeholder }} tokens only -- no expression evaluation), so a malicious template cannot execute code or trigger SSRF.

body.description: Receipt body template using {{ placeholder }} tokens only (no expression evaluation). Optional -- when empty a built-in default layout is used.

layoutWidth.description: Thermal printer line width in characters

companyLogoUrl.description: Optional URL to a company logo for the receipt header

isInvoiceMode.description: When true, always render the legal-invoice (BTW breakdown + compliance footer) variant. Transactions >= EUR 100 render as an invoice regardless of this flag.

organizationId.description: Optional UUID of the owning organization for multi-tenant isolation

receiptPrintLog.title: Receipt Print Log
receiptPrintLog.summary: An append-only audit entry for a printed or emailed POS receipt
receiptPrintLog.description: Immutable audit trail of every receipt print and email action for compliance. Entries are append-only and never updated after creation. Mapped to Schema.org Action.

transaction.description: UUID reference to the posTransaction the receipt was issued for

template.description: UUID reference to the receiptTemplate used (may be empty for the default layout)

printerDevice.description: Configured printer IP:port or device name (for print actions)

actor.description: Nextcloud user UID of the user who performed the action

renderedContent.description: The rendered receipt content captured for audit
